scope: 默认分支、README 已提取目标及已有安装映射；不穷举历史版本、不安装或执行插件

description.en: Re-maps the interface onto CDS: warm-gray surfaces, clay brand accent, dual-ring focus and organic motion, with component-level refinement of the composer, sidebar, message rows and code blocks.
description.zh: 把界面重映射到 CDS：暖灰表面、陶土橙品牌色、双环焦点与有机动效，并对输入框、侧栏、消息行与代码块做组件级细化。

plugin.name: dsh-system-fonts
plugin.title: dsh-system-fonts
plugin.description: DeepSeek Harness 的纯字体插件：把内容/代码/终端三个系统字体选择器放进通用设置里宿主可折叠的字体区（分别紧跟官方族名行，折叠时一并收起），按字体族枚举 Windows 已装字体，另带行距与字距；字重与字号归宿主主题，文案随宿主语言切换。只改字体，不动配色与版式。 / Pure font plugin for DeepSeek Harness: seats text/code/terminal system-font pickers inside the host's collapsible font region in General settings (each after the official family row it replaces, collapsing with it), enumerating installed Windows fonts, plus line-height and letter-spacing; weights and sizes stay with the host theme and copy follows the host language. Fonts only — no colors, no layout.
plugin.author: HwFee

description.en: A usage panel under the blank-session headline: sessions, messages, total tokens, active days, peak hour, favourite model, an activity heatmap, and a token comparison against a Chinese novel.
description.zh: 在新对话页的标题下方显示一张用量面板：会话数、消息数、总 token、活跃天数、高峰时段、常用模型、活跃度热力图，以及按中文字数折算的趣味对比。

description.en: Let the model answer with a live React card. render_ui runs the snippet in a plugin-owned sandbox and renders it inline in the conversation; one built-in skill teaches when a card beats prose.
description.zh: 让模型用一张可交互的 React 卡片来回答。render_ui 在插件自有沙箱里执行代码并就地渲染；附一个内置 skill，教模型什么时候该用界面、什么时候一段文字就够。

description.en: After each reply, a quiet grey suggestion of what you might type next appears in the composer. Press Tab to accept it into the box.
description.zh: 每轮回答结束后，输入框里用浅色文字预测你接下来会说什么。按 Tab 填入，不会发送。

description.en: Run shell commands in Git Bash instead of PowerShell. Resolves the real Git for Windows bash (not the WSL stub), exposes a run_shell tool, and shows which shell is in effect.
description.zh: 用 Git Bash 而不是 PowerShell 执行 shell 命令。自动定位真正的 Git for Windows bash（不用 WSL 的替身），提供 run_shell 工具，并在设置里显示当前用的是哪个 shell。
